description.value: Tom Hopkins Ravine Park protects over 6.5 hectares of sensitive second-growth forest ravine ecosystem in Surrey, with more than 1 km of Delta Creek running through it. Natural area trails in the west section of the park offer a quiet forest walk, with a pedestrian bridge crossing Delta Creek. Access is from 98A or 99 Avenue, and most of the ravine interior is inaccessible to protect the sensitive habitat.
